text: I feel a quiet exhilaration in this space of curiosity and innovation. Surrounded by glass walls and vibrant displays labeled R+D, I am compelled to reflect on the relationship between knowledge, discovery, and creative progress. There’s an electric sense of purpose here, tempered by the sterile clarity of the architecture—a kind of intellectual sanctuary that invites contemplation. I feel both small and significant among the possibilities of what could be achieved when thought meets experimentation.
